instruction: Use bw config to set the Bitwarden server URL to a specific instance
Use bw config to set the Bitwarden CLI client ID for API key auth
Use bw config to set the Bitwarden CLI client secret
Use bw confirm for organization membership
Use bw list items --trash to view deleted items
Use bw list org-collections with organization ID
Use bw list organization with user's email for filtering
Use op run with a bash command to inject secrets from 1Password
Use op inject to substitute secrets into a config file from stdin
Use op read to get a secret value from 1Password
Use op read to get a specific field from an item
Use op item create for a software license
output: op item create --category software_license --title 'VS Code' --vault Private --fields 'license_key=XXXX-XXXX-XXXX'

instruction: Use op item create for an email account
output: op item create --category email_account --title 'Work Email' --vault Private --username user@work.com --password 'em@ilP@ss' --fields 'smtp_host=smtp.work.com,imap_host=imap.work.com'

instruction: Use op item get and output to file
Use op item list with formatting
output: op item list --vault Private --format json | jq '.[].title'
